description: RFC 8785 edge vectors for the Creator Provenance Protocol. `accept` pins the canonical bytes; `reject` pins which inputs are refused and why. Every `accept` output was confirmed byte-identical against serde_jcs 0.2.0 and the canonicalize npm package 3.0.0. `alsoRejectedBySerdeJcs` records where this implementation is deliberately stricter than RFC 8785 requires; see protocol/CANONICALIZATION.md.

accept.name: number-minus-zero
accept.description: the sign of zero is dropped

accept.name: number-integral-forms
accept.description: trailing zeros and exponents collapse to the shortest ES6 form

accept.name: number-exponent-threshold
accept.description: ES6 switches to exponent notation at 1e21 and at 1e-7

accept.name: number-extremes
accept.description: the smallest denormal and the largest finite double

accept.name: number-max-safe-integer
accept.description: the largest consecutive integer, and 2^53 itself, which is exact

accept.name: number-large-integral-roundtrip
accept.description: a plain integer literal above 2^53 is fine when it round-trips exactly

accept.name: number-rounding-is-expected
accept.description: an inexact literal is serialized as the double it parsed to

accept.name: string-short-escapes
accept.description: the C0 controls with short forms, and the two characters that must be escaped

accept.name: string-long-escapes
accept.description: C0 controls without a short form use lowercase \u00xx

accept.name: string-not-escaped
accept.description: solidus, DEL, U+0080 and the line separators stay literal

accept.name: string-astral
accept.description: a surrogate pair is one character in the output

accept.name: key-order-code-units
accept.description: sorting is by UTF-16 code unit, so an astral key sorts before U+FB33

accept.name: key-order-ascii
accept.description: empty key first, digits before letters, uppercase before lowercase

accept.name: key-order-prefix
accept.description: a shorter key sorts before a longer one that extends it

accept.name: nesting-empty
accept.description: empty containers survive at every depth

accept.name: literals
accept.description: the three JSON literals

accept.name: array-order-preserved
accept.description: arrays are not sorted

accept.name: whitespace-insignificant
accept.description: every RFC 8259 whitespace form between tokens

accept.name: top-level-scalar
accept.description: a bare string is a valid JSON document

accept.name: top-level-array
accept.description: so is a bare array

accept.name: duplicate-key-in-nested-objects
accept.description: the same name in sibling objects is not a duplicate

reject.name: duplicate-key
reject.description: two members with the same name
reject.error: duplicate member name "a" at offset 7

reject.name: duplicate-key-escaped
reject.description: the same name written two different ways
reject.error: duplicate member name "a" at offset 7

reject.name: duplicate-key-nested
reject.description: a duplicate inside a nested object
reject.error: duplicate member name "a" at offset 22

reject.name: number-overflow
reject.description: a literal outside the IEEE-754 double range
reject.error: number 1E400 is outside the IEEE-754 double range at offset 5

reject.name: number-overflow-negative
reject.description: the same, negative
reject.error: number -1E400 is outside the IEEE-754 double range at offset 5

reject.name: integer-precision-loss
reject.description: an integer literal with more digits than a double holds
reject.error: integer literal 12345678901234567890 needs more precision than IEEE-754 double provides; it would be hashed as 12345678901234567000 at offset 5

reject.name: integer-precision-loss-boundary
reject.description: the smallest integer a double cannot represent exactly
reject.error: integer literal 9007199254740993 needs more precision than IEEE-754 double provides; it would be hashed as 9007199254740992 at offset 5

reject.name: lone-high-surrogate
reject.description: an unpaired high surrogate
reject.error: unpaired high surrogate U+D800 at offset 13

reject.name: lone-low-surrogate
reject.description: an unpaired low surrogate
reject.error: unpaired low surrogate U+DC00 at offset 13

reject.name: reversed-surrogate-pair
reject.description: a low surrogate before a high one
reject.error: unpaired low surrogate U+DC00 at offset 19

reject.name: lone-surrogate-in-key
reject.description: an unpaired surrogate in a member name
reject.error: unpaired low surrogate U+DFFF at offset 9

reject.name: unescaped-control
reject.description: a literal newline inside a string
reject.error: unescaped control character U+000a at offset 7

reject.name: leading-zero
reject.description: a number with a leading zero
reject.error: expected "}" at offset 6

reject.name: leading-plus
reject.description: an explicitly signed number
reject.error: unexpected character "+" at offset 5

reject.name: bare-fraction
reject.description: a number with no integer part
reject.error: unexpected character "." at offset 5

reject.name: trailing-dot
reject.description: a number with no fraction digits
reject.error: expected a digit after '.' at offset 7

reject.name: nan-literal
reject.description: NaN is not JSON
reject.error: unexpected character "N" at offset 5

reject.name: infinity-literal
reject.description: neither is Infinity
reject.error: unexpected character "I" at offset 5

reject.name: trailing-comma
reject.description: a trailing comma in an object
reject.error: expected a member name at offset 7

reject.name: trailing-comma-array
reject.description: a trailing comma in an array
reject.error: unexpected character "]" at offset 5

reject.name: single-quotes
reject.description: single-quoted strings are not JSON
reject.error: expected a member name at offset 1

reject.name: unquoted-key
reject.description: an unquoted member name
reject.error: expected a member name at offset 1

reject.name: vertical-tab-whitespace
reject.description: U+000B is not JSON whitespace
reject.error: unexpected character "\u000b" at offset 5

reject.name: trailing-content
reject.description: a second value after the document
reject.error: trailing content after the top-level value at offset 8

reject.name: empty-input
reject.description: no document at all
reject.error: unexpected end of input at offset 0

reject.name: comment
reject.description: JSON has no comments
reject.error: expected "}" at offset 7
